CustomField.description: Sum of the allocation percentages recorded against this meter. Lets a reviewer see at a glance that a shared meter is fully, over or under allocated. Zero or blank on a meter that serves a single space and needs no split.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Adds up the Allocation Percent on the Meter Allocations below. On a shared meter this should normally reach 100. Anything else means the split is incomplete or double counted.
CustomField.label: Total Allocated Percent
